subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “One display showed a device that was too difficult for customers to use.”?
options: Another showed a product that solved a problem few people actually had.
Back in the city, the night sky showed only a few stars.
It is about whether people can actually move with safety and dignity.
They also showed people how to check soil and sunlight.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「One display showed a device that was too difficult for customers to use. Another showed a product that solved a problem few…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Back in the city, the night sky showed only a few stars.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It is about whether people can actually move with safety and dignity.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「One display showed a device that was too difficult for customers to use. Another showed a product that solved a problem few people actually…」，答案為「Another showed a product that solved a problem few people actually had.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Another showed a product that solved a problem few people actually had.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
